78. This is consistent with my understanding that the FS Water Tank repair works would be carried out in phases, rather than across all 8 buildings at the same time.

79. From pages 1271, 1279, 1287, 1305 and 1315, I note that the reports record that works had been carried out on the FS Water Tanks.

80. I further note that in the progress reports dated after 11 October 2025 (pages 1326, 1338, 1359 and 1391), the entries relating to FS Water Tank repair works are blank. I am unsure whether this indicates that the works had been completed by that time, or simply that no further work was carried out after that date.

81. In any event, I repeat that Gordon and Mr Cheung did not inform me that the repair works had been completed.

FSD Calls  
82. From time to time, the FSD would contact me directly to enquire about the progress of the works.

83. One such instance occurred in or around September 2025, as recorded in Bundle B2 FSD (1408), which is a document produced by the FSD indicating that they contacted me to enquire about the progress.

84. That record states that the FH/HR system was inoperative due to FS Water Tank maintenance, and that an inspection was conducted by the relevant officers with TP/MP crew at about 15:20 hours on 9 September 2025. During that inspection, it was found that the situation was consistent with the description provided by the RFSIC.

85. This indicates that, as at 9 September 2025, FS Water Tank repair works were in fact being carried out.
